text: Meet Cortex. A super brain that lives in your Mac notch.
Ask Cortex what someone said, find a forgotten detail, and get back to the original conversation.
Tell it what matters, and save a permanent memory for later.
Cortex captures available text across your screen, building local context for you and your agents.
It's also a shared task manager. Hit your limit in Codex? Open Claude. Your tasks, progress, and handoff notes are ready to continue.
One local-first memory. For you and your agents. Completely open source.
